snippet.title: DHALMAN | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A single-player action adventure that blends Metroidvania exploration, fighting-style boss battles, and curry restaurant simulation in a vibrant world inspired by India. Across several countries, face bosses that grow stronger as you fight, and expand your curry shop on the journey to build the world’s greatest curry shop.

Play the Steam demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353710/DHALMAN/
